name: China Glass Holdings Limited
summary: China Glass Holdings Limited, founded in 1958 and based in Central, Hong Kong, produces, markets and distributes glass products. Its markets include mainland China, Hong Kong, Nigeria, the Middle East, Italy and Kazakhstan, and it ships to about 90 countries and regions. Segments cover clear, painted and coated glass, energy-saving and new-energy glass such as photovoltaic modules, and design and installation services for glass production lines.
